summary: P1 Tasks testing complete - Both features working. PlayerDetailPage navigation from dashboard works correctly. DvP calculation now uses real NBA team defensive rankings instead of placeholder 0.5.

player_card_navigation.feature: Clicking player card on dashboard navigates to PlayerDetailPage
player_card_navigation.evidence: Clicked Safe Haven pick card -> navigated to PlayerDetailPage for Precious Achiuwa

player_header_photo.feature: PlayerDetailPage shows player photo in header
player_header_photo.evidence: Header shows player headshot image for Precious Achiuwa

player_header_info.feature: PlayerDetailPage shows player name, team, position

demon_goblin_counts.evidence: Header shows red icon with '19' (demons) and green icon with '9' (goblins)

accordion_expand_collapse.feature: Category accordions expand and collapse correctly
accordion_expand_collapse.evidence: Clicked 'Other' category -> expanded to show 28 prop rows

back_button.evidence: Clicked back button -> returned to dashboard with PICKVISION header visible

props_demon_goblin_icons.feature: Props show demon/goblin icons and line values
props_demon_goblin_icons.evidence: Prop rows show green goblin icons, line values (0.5, 1.5, 2.5), Over direction, L10/L5 rates

dvp_real_data.feature: DvP calculation uses real team defensive rankings
dvp_real_data.evidence: Goblin vault picks show varying dvp_modifier values (0.379-0.966) based on opponent, not placeholder 0.5

dvp_implementation_details.data_source: DVP_RANKINGS_2024_25 hardcoded dictionary with NBA team defensive rankings by stat category
dvp_implementation_details.calculation: calculate_dvp_modifier(opponent_team, stat_type) converts team rank (1-30) to modifier (0.0-1.0)

code_changes_made.change: Added opponent calculation in _build_cached_board() - calculates opponent from home_team/away_team
Added opponent calculation in _build_cached_board_legacy() - same fix for legacy fallback
Added opponent calculation in run_full_sync() - for player_data collection
Changed get_cached_player() to read from cached_board first (has opponent data), then fall back to player_data

critical_code_review_comments: DvP rankings are hardcoded for 2024-25 season (DVP_RANKINGS_2024_25) - will need manual update each season
Combo stats (PRA, P+R, P+A, R+A) DvP calculated as average of component stat rankings
PlayerDetailPage correctly receives and displays all player data from cached-player API
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 tasks complete. PlayerDetailPage navigation working. DvP now uses real team rankings from DVP_RANKINGS_2024_25 dictionary. Opponent is calculated from home_team/away_team props and stored in cached_board. get_cached_player now reads from cached_board first for latest data.
